1) Yes, the layout follows the YouTube structure (top bar, left rail, chip filter bar, grid of video cards, no hero banner).
2) Yes, the background is a light/near-white field consistent with YouTube's light default.
3) Yes, the cards show real photographic thumbnails.
4) Yes, there is a persistent "Install app" floating prompt in the left rail that YouTube does not show in this manner on desktop.
5) Yes, there is non-YouTube chrome: the branding says "WebFlix" instead of "YouTube," includes a "live service" badge, and uses "wfx-experience-service" as the channel name for all videos.
